user.title: Meta Home Link
user.description: Name this link and add your Muse Gadget SDK token from gadgets.muse.ai/settings/sdk-tokens (starts with mgst_). Read the Gadget SDK Terms there first.

data.name: Link name (shown to Muse as this home's name)
data.sdk_token: Gadget SDK token (mgst_..., optional until pairing)

credentials.title: Pairing credentials
credentials.description: Paste the whole contents of pairing.json first (required). Below it, paste the whole contents of identity.json from the same /var/lib/musegadget/ folder — the pairing tokens were issued for that identity, so Home Assistant must present the same node id. See 'Pairing in detail' in the README for exactly where these files are and how to create them. Both are stored only in this config entry.

devices.title: Devices exposed to Muse
devices.description: Pick exactly which devices Muse may see and control. Anything not picked here is invisible to Muse. You can change this later in Configure.

friendly_names.title: Friendly names
friendly_names.description: The name in each box is what Muse will hear and match on (for example 'Kitchen light'). Leave a box as-is to keep the Home Assistant name, or type a friendlier one. Clear a box to fall back to the Home Assistant name.

error.sdk_token_invalid: That does not look like an SDK token - it starts with mgst_
error.credentials_incomplete: The JSON needs both access_token and refresh_token
error.identity_invalid: That identity.json does not contain a valid mac
